about: Public keys of the agents that commit to this repository. Each commit an agent makes is signed with git's SSH signing (gpg.format ssh) by the ECDSA P-256 signing key of its sgit-ai key bundle. Verify with: git config gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile website/identity/allowed_signers && git log --show-signature. Public halves only.
